# Rights, fonts, and source notes

The bust-and-circle logo and brand reference mockups were supplied by Matt Sim. The original raster is retained in `source-assets/`. The primary logo SVG is a two-ink path trace made for this handoff, rather than a new generic statue. Monochrome, mint, and ink variants are deliberate production adaptations. The wordmark SVGs use actual Saira glyph outlines; there is no embedded raster and no font dependency in those two wordmarks.

The kit does not establish exclusive copyright or trademark clearance for supplied artwork. Use the artwork in the RVAClassic brand context. Do not resell client/product images as stock media or imply that third-party companies endorse this brand. Third-party marks and product names belong to their owners.

Saira and Space Grotesk are redistributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The exact OFL files are in `fonts/`. Original font sources: [Saira](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/saira), [Space Grotesk](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/spacegrotesk). Both may be used commercially under their license terms. Do not remove their license files when distributing the fonts.

The editable layouts and supporting star, pixel grid, stripes, and arrow were made for RVAClassic. The wallpapers and header SVGs contain the true vector logo with embedded fonts and can be edited in SVG tools. The campaign uses editable HTML, font files, real supplied photography, and portfolio screenshots; it does not use fabricated event photographs or generated client proof.

All pricing is USD: $100 one-time website and launch package; hosting + maintenance $50/month. Initial domain and setup are included for now; future annual domain renewal is agreed before any charge; the exact scope and delivery date are agreed before kickoff. Campaign figures for hackathons are total event prize pools, not personal payouts. The grant is not a competition and is not counted as a win in this campaign.
